description:
Fetch one page (a domain's homepage, or `url`) and report its meta tags, JSON-LD types, headings, robots.txt (sitemaps, AI crawlers blocked site-wide), whether /llms.txt is served, bot protection, and Core Web Vitals from PageSpeed Insights (PSI), mobile and desktop, graded.

Billing: 2¢ per page after 3 free pages a day; a page already audited today (incl. the PSI re-poll) or that didn't load is free. Many pages: crawl_site (1¢ per 10 pages) is cheaper; a crawled site's pages read free with get_latest_crawl. 30/hour per host.

Inputs: domain — hostname or URL (its homepage). url — optional exact URL instead (kept as given; ports other than 80/443 refused). include_pagespeed — default true; false answers in seconds. refresh_pagespeed — default false; true ignores cached readings.

Timing: ~10 s. A PSI strategy not done by then is "pending" and keeps measuring: call again after pagespeed_retry_after_seconds (free). Cached 10 min (errors 2).

Returns: { url, final_url, redirected, fetched_at, response_status, fetch_error, meta, schema_types, headings, robots: { found, status, sitemaps, ai_crawlers: { allowed, blocked, fix } | null }, llms_txt: { url, found, status, problem, generator? }, pagespeed: { mobile, desktop } | null, cwv_summary?, pagespeed_note?, bot_protection?, billing, latest_crawl?, suggested_next, next_step }. bot_protection { verdict: checker_refused|ai_blocked|verifies_bots, note, fix? }: a firewall refused us or ChatGPT-User whatever robots.txt allows (verifies_bots: a faked Googlebot was refused too, so real crawlers may pass); relay its note. Each strategy: { status: ok|error|pending, measuredAt, score (0–100), lcpSec, inpMs, inpSource, clsUnitless, fcpSec, ttfbSec, tbtMs, field, grades, error }. Lab values: one Lighthouse run. inpMs and field (source url|origin, or null): real-user CrUX p75. grades: { metrics: { <metric>: { value, rating: good|needs_improvement|poor, source: lab|field_url|field_origin } }, core_web_vitals: pass|fail|null (field only), worst }. cwv_summary: metrics past good.

domain.description: Hostname or URL, e.g. "linear.app". The homepage is fetched unless `url` is set.

include_pagespeed.description: Default true. false skips PageSpeed Insights / Core Web Vitals for a fast meta + schema + robots check.

refresh_pagespeed.description: Default false. true skips cached Core Web Vitals and measures again, e.g. to verify a performance fix.

url.description: Optional exact URL to fetch instead of the homepage, e.g. https://example.com/llms.txt. Fetched as given.

name: run_technical_audit
title: Run a technical SEO audit on a homepage
